scope: production M1-F recomputation of the accepted layer-3 M1-F0 route

rounding_model.rms_norm: componentwise input propagation through square/sum/mean/epsilon/sqrt/reciprocal/two multiplies, using the positive lower endpoint of mean_square+epsilon and outward f64 evaluation
rounding_model.position_zero_attention: single visible value makes attention weight exactly one; Q/K score error does not propagate into the value branch
rounding_model.residual: attention_output_abs_error plus one outward-rounded f32 addition
rounding_model.bias: input-independent exact f32 operand promoted to f64; include one outward f64 addition rounding

rank_bounds.B8: componentwise absolute post-bias score-error bound for accepted rank-8 expert
rank_bounds.B9: componentwise absolute post-bias score-error bound for accepted rank-9 expert

selection.tie_break: descending score then lower expert ID
